summary: Converts TOP image pixels into SOP points by raster scanning the image for laser, oscilloscope, and similar point-output workflows.

key_params.name: downloadtype
key_params.note: Immediate slow download or faster next-frame GPU download

common_gotchas: Source image resolution directly controls output point count.
Use Trace SOP when contour paths are needed instead of one point per pixel.
Immediate GPU download can stall rendering; next-frame download is faster but adds a frame of latency.
key_concepts: Raster SOP scans TOP image data and outputs one SOP point for each pixel.
It is intended for point-output workflows such as laser devices and oscilloscopes, often feeding Laser CHOP-style systems.
Raster SOP differs from Trace SOP, which outputs contour shapes instead of every sampled pixel.
